svg.title: Which discount applies first
svg.desc: Every hour, EC2 usage is covered in this order: first Reserved Instances that match it; then EC2 Instance Savings Plans, the narrower plans; then Compute Savings Plans; inside each plan the usage with the highest savings percentage is covered first until the hour's commitment is used; whatever is left is billed at On-Demand rates. Spot usage is billed separately at the Spot price and is never covered by Savings Plans. An unused hour of commitment is lost.
svg.text: Which discount applies first
One hour of usage, covered layer by layer; what is left is On-Demand
1. Reserved Instances
exact match on type, Region, OS, tenancy
2. EC2 Instance Savings Plans
narrower plan first
3. Compute Savings Plans
what the others left
4. On-Demand
everything still uncovered
Spot: billed apart, at the Spot price
never covered by Savings Plans, never uses their commitment
Inside a plan
Usage with the highest savings percentage goes first,
until the hour's commitment is used up.
An hour's commitment covers only that hour:
unused commitment is lost, not carried over.
Capacity Reservations
discounts go to running instances first, then unused capacity
In an Organization with sharing on, plans cover the owning account first, then the others.
